messages:
zara: Heads-up: deploy-bot blocked the release cut. Promotion preflight failed with a manifest digest mismatch for redwood/inference:canary-20260323.

deploy-bot: system: promotion suspended - manifest-digest-conflict detected for tag 'canary-20260323'. Lock acquired.

ci-runner: publish logs: push manifest sha256:5f8a1c... at 09:10:42Z. mirror-sync job shows blob fetch 502 at 09:11:05Z then a retry that created manifest sha256:aa77d2... at 09:12:10Z.

ethan: So two manifests existed briefly. Could be mirror partial-write. Change window opens in 40m. Options: pin to primary digest and manual promote, or rollback/rebuild. Pin is fastest.

kelsey: Agree pin+smoke. But we need to validate blob HEADs across mirrors before forcing. If a mirror has missing blobs, some hosts might 404.

juan: Quick checks I can run: skopeo inspect against primary and mirrors, then curl HEAD on top 2 blobs. If all 200, promote with digest flag.

infra-bot: Suggested procedure: 1) verify primary digest with skopeo; 2) verify blob HEAD 200 on all mirrors; 3) run `deploy-bot promote --tag canary-20260323 --expected-digest sha256:5f8a1c... --manual-approve`; 4) smoke pulls (3 replicas per region). Open INFRA ticket if replication is flaky.

juan: Running checks now. primary digest=sha256:5f8a1c9d. mirror-eu returned aa77d2 earlier but rechecked -> 5f8a1c9d now. Blob HEADs (top2): primary 200, mirror-eu 200, mirror-us 200.

zara: Good. Who will run promote?

kelsey: I will. Promoting with expected-digest sha256:5f8a1c9d and forcing unlock.

deploy-bot: promotion resumed by @kelsey with pinned digest sha256:5f8a1c9d. promo-id=promo-1745609999-3.

ci-runner: smoke started (eu-west 3 replicas). Pulls: r1 ok, r2 transient 504 then ok, r3 ok. No blob 404.

ethan: Looks green. Please open infra ticket to prevent manifest re-writing on partial replication (INFRA-2199) and add a pre-promotion mirror-consistency check to release runbook.

zara: Created INFRA-2199 and updated release notes: "manual digest pin to sha256:5f8a1c9d due to transient mirror replication race; mirrors healthy post-retry; follow-up INFRA-2199." Unblocking change window.

deploy-bot: promotion completed; release window cleared.

zara: Thanks all. Closing thread. :thumbsup:
